units.source_text: “常胜名人”在一生中最后一次的围棋赛上败北了。

en.t: The "ever-victorious Master" was defeated in the last Go match of his life.

units.source_text: 因此名人应该最不愿意在对局室里停留。

en.t: For that reason, the Master should have been the one least willing to remain in the playing room.

units.source_text: 再说，他带病参战，要消除疲劳，也应该尽早换个地方才是。

en.t: Besides, since he had played while ill, he ought to have changed places as soon as possible in order to recover from his fatigue.

units.source_text: 然而难道是名人对此心不在焉，或是感觉迟钝？

en.t: And yet, was the Master simply inattentive to this, or had his senses grown dull?

units.source_text: 连工作人员和观战的我，都觉得再不能在这里待下去，赶紧逃脱似的回家去了，唯独失利的名人却留下来。

en.t: Even the staff and I, who had been watching the match, felt we could no longer stay there and hurried home as if escaping, but the defeated Master alone remained behind.

units.source_text: 他这种郁闷而乏味的生活，任凭人们去想象吧。

en.t: As for that gloomy and tedious life of his, let people imagine it for themselves.

units.source_text: 他本人大概依然像往常一样若无其事，茫然地坐着。

en.t: He himself was probably still sitting there blankly, as if nothing had happened, just as usual.
